Noah Rivera: opened PR 1589 to migrate the pricing tiers doc to the new billing model and add a Go SDK snippet for quota checks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1589. Also swapped the grafana panel screenshot to the new dashboard.
Priya Kapoor: quick glance looks good. did you update the tier table that maps old T1/T2 to S1/S2? we need that to avoid support tickets.
Noah Rivera: yes, added a migration table and a short note about rate-limit deltas (S1 has higher baseline tokens/sec). left a TODO to confirm exact numbers with finance.
Jordan Lee: heads-up: the grafana panel ids changed after the dashboard refactor. the screenshot in the PR points to panel 42 which no longer exists. i can update the snapshot and attach the right panel JSON.
Hana Ito: Finance confirmed token units changed for embeddings: meter unit is now per 1000 tokens, not 100. that affects the examples and the cost-per-call calculations. pls update math in the pricing examples.
Noah Rivera: thanks Hana. i'll update the cost table and recalc the worked examples. also adding a clear note about "meter unit" so customers know how billing scales.
Docs Lint Bot: Broken image link detected in docs/pricing/tiers.md -> img/dashboard-snapshot.png. Suggested fix: re-upload image to docs/assets and update path.
Noah Rivera: reuploaded new image to docs/assets/grafana/summary-panel-v2.png and changed the md reference. pushed commit.
Docs CI: Linkcheck failed on anchor #rate-limits-overview in pricing/tiers.md (HTTP 200 but anchor not found). See CI job: https://ci.redwood-inference/jobs/98765
Priya Kapoor: the anchor was renamed when we split the rate-limits page. either restore the anchor or update the link to point to /docs/rate-limits/overview.md. which do we prefer?
Jordan Lee: prefer updating link to the new page, keep files decoupled. i'll open a tiny PR to fix cross-doc links after this merges.
Hana Ito: small request — in the Go snippet please include a graceful fallback when quota info is missing. many private deployments don't surface meter headers. example we use in python should be mirrored: defensive parse + comment.
Noah Rivera: added Go snippet with defensive parse. snippet: ```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
)
func main(){
  resp, _ := http.Get("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage")
  hdr := resp.Header.Get("X-Quota-Remaining")
  if hdr == "" {
    fmt.Println("quota: unknown (fallback)")
  } else {
    fmt.Println("quota:", hdr)
  }
}
```
Priya Kapoor: nice. please also add a one-sentence note that Dedicated may omit headers depending on routing, similar to other samples.
Noah Rivera: added that note and a short FAQ row. updated the migration table to include Customer Impact column.
Docs Lint Bot: markdown lint warning: pricing/tiers.md line 112 - long line exceeds 100 chars. minor but please wrap.
Noah Rivera: fixed wrap and pushed.

Jordan Lee: runtime confirmation: S1 baseline = 120 tokens/sec, S2 baseline = 450 tokens/sec for gen endpoints. added a comment in PR with perf doc link.
Hana Ito: product confirms migration messaging and approves the FAQ addition.
Noah Rivera: merging now. followups: Jordan to open link-fix PR for other docs, Priya to notify support + changelog entry, Hana to verify examples in the billing calculator. closing thread. :tada:
